claims.summary: QSOL explicitly prioritizes small, fast, local-first, transparent software with clarity over complexity.
Multiple current QSOL projects use deterministic replay, canonical hashing, provenance receipts, or explicit reproducibility contracts as core methods.
Current research repositories repeatedly separate computational/formal assurance from stronger empirical, physical, psychological, or ontological claims.
Offline-first and dependency-light browser tools recur across the public QSOL software ecosystem.

nonclaims: these recurring patterns do not imply every QSOLKCB repository follows every listed principle
this file is not a complete biography, private memory store, or exhaustive project inventory
